at the AImotion Bavaria research institute of Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt (Germany), we are currently looking for a Research Engineer (m/f/d) for the new XPerience Lab. The position offers the opportunity to shape and operate a state-of-the-art immersive research environment and contribute to cutting-edge research in Human-Computer Interaction, Human-AI Interaction, and eXtended Reality. The successful candidate will work in an interdisciplinary team at Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt and collaborate closely with researchers from engineering, computer science, and design.

Your responsibilities will include:

•

Set up, commission, and operate the new Xperience Lab at the Digital Building of THI, including a CAVE environment, stereoscopic visualization, optical tracking, audio systems, and a digital twin.

•

Integrate the Xperience Lab into the research infrastructure of the AImotion Bavaria research institute.

•

Design and implement XR applications using technologies such as Unity, Unreal Engine, and CARLA, including movement tracking and interactive experiences.

•

Develop and conduct AR/VR/XR-based experimental studies and connect the lab to other research facilities and interdisciplinary projects.

•

Conduct independent research and publish in leading international venues.

•

Contribute to science communication and knowledge transfer activities.

•

Teach courses equivalent to 4 semester hours per week and contribute to academic administration and service.

Qualifications:

•

Excellent degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Computer Science, Media Informatics, Media Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline.

• Strong programming skills in at least one high-level language (e.g., C#, .NET, Java) and prior experience developing XR applications.
•

Good knowledge of immersive visualization systems, optical tracking technologies, and spatial audio/acoustics.

•

Excellent English proficiency (C1) and good German language skills (B2).

• Strong interest in interdisciplinary research, particularly at the intersection of humans and technology, and enthusiasm for scientific work.

About the Position:

•

Application deadline: June 24, 2026

•

100% full-time position

•

TV-L E13 salary scale

•

Initial contract duration until June 30, 2028 (with the possibility of extension)
